search.description: Search publications (Woo decisions, reports, policy documents) by title, organisation, status, publication date or retention category. Answers only the publications the caller may read; the public sees a publication once its publication date has passed.

get.description: Get one publication by id, with its title, summary, organisation, themes, status and publication dates. For the Nextcloud files stored on it, use opencatalogi.listPublicationFiles.

search.description: Search the catalogs of this instance by title, organisation, status, whether they are listed, or slug. A catalog groups publications from a set of registers and schemas; to search the publications inside one, use opencatalogi.searchCatalogPublications.

get.description: Get one catalog by id: its title, summary, organisation, status, slug and the registers and schemas it spans.

search.description: Search the themes publications are filed under, by title or sort order. Use it to turn a theme id on a publication into its name.

get.description: Get one theme by id: its title, summary and description.
